title: Super Admin in-app dashboard access + pending-user approval gating (Firestore roles/approval)

requirements.summary: Show a Super Admin-only navigation entry in the profile/avatar dropdown that routes to the admin area using Firestore `users/{uid}.role` only.
acceptanceCriteria: When the logged-in Firestore profile has `role === "super_admin"`, the profile/avatar dropdown shows an explicit navigation item (e.g., "Admin Dashboard" or "User Approval") that routes to the admin area.
When the logged-in Firestore profile has `role === "user"`, no admin navigation item is shown.
Admin visibility logic uses only Firestore profile data (not Firebase Auth fields).

file_operations.description: Adjust the admin menu item visibility logic to be strictly `role === "super_admin"` (not helper_admin) and ensure the label remains English. Keep using only the Firestore-provided `userProfile` prop for role/name/photo decisions (no Firebase Auth displayName/photoURL). Use existing shadcn-ui DropdownMenu primitives already in this file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure any admin-related navigation triggered from the avatar/profile entry point remains consistent with Super Admin-only access (avoid helper_admin being treated as 'admin dashboard access' for this requirement) and continues binding user display fields from Firestore profile data only. Use existing shadcn-ui Avatar primitives already in this file. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Provide an in-app Super Admin pending-users screen that shows full signup details for each pending user and supports approve/reject actions with refresh.
acceptanceCriteria: The admin screen lists pending users (Firestore `approved == false`) and shows their signup fields (at minimum: fullName, age, relation, phoneNumber, email, photoURL) in the UI for super admins.
Each pending user row has actions to approve and reject; approving sets `approved=true` (and clears `rejected`), rejecting sets `rejected=true` and keeps `approved=false`.
After performing an action, the pending list refreshes and the updated user no longer appears as pending when approved.

file_operations.description: Enhance the pending users list UI so Super Admins can review complete signup details per user (including photoURL, email, phoneNumber, age, relation, fullName) without relying on truncated table columns; wire in a details view (e.g., per-row dialog) while keeping the existing pending-users query and approve/reject actions. Use existing shadcn-ui Card/Table/Badge/Avatar primitives already in this screen. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Ensure the approve/reject actions remain clearly available for pending users and stay English-only, and (if needed for the details review UX) add a secondary action to open the pending-user details view without changing any files under `frontend/src/components/ui`. Continue to rely on parent-provided callbacks that update Firestore and refresh queries. Use existing shadcn-ui DropdownMenu/AlertDialog primitives already in this component. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Create a reusable admin-only dialog component to display the full pending user's signup fields (fullName, age, relation, phoneNumber, email, photoURL) in a readable layout for Super Admin review. Use shadcn-ui dialog primitives (from existing project components) for consistent UI. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Gate unapproved users into an in-app pending approval screen and display the exact message text "Pending approval for admin".
acceptanceCriteria: If a user’s Firestore profile has `approved === false`, the app routes them to the pending approval screen instead of main app screens.
The pending approval screen includes the exact phrase "Pending approval for admin" somewhere in the visible text (English).
Approved users do not see the pending approval screen on login.

file_operations.description: Add centralized approval gating: when an authenticated Firestore profile is loaded and `approved === false`, force navigation/rendering to `/pending-approval` for non-auth routes (e.g., /chat, /users, /profile, and admin routes), while allowing approved users to proceed normally. Keep routing logic English-only and continue using Firestore profile as the source of truth.

Update the pending approval UI copy to include the exact visible phrase "Pending approval for admin" (English) while keeping the existing layout components. Use existing shadcn-ui Card/Alert/Button primitives already imported here. Verify the component's usage instructions before implementing.

Add an approval-aware check so that authenticated-but-unapproved users are not allowed to render protected main-app content; instead trigger a redirect/navigation callback to the pending approval screen (or integrate with the App-level gating if that is the chosen single source of truth). Continue to rely on Firestore profile data via `useFirestoreUserProfile` and keep all user-facing text English.
